text_block_list.text:
One day, while training for the Arima 
Kinen, Nice Nature caught sight of Tokai 
Teio hard at work with her rehabilitation.

She never slacks on her efforts, no matter 
the situation. Yet, when she first got 
injured, she had shed tears of 
frustration.

Realizing that what set them apart was 
whether or not she possessed the power to 
stand up on her own, Nice Nature—

Casting aside her weak self, her desire to 
"win" grew all the stronger.
